['Select canonical_smiles, substrate_record_id, metabolite_record_id, substrate_compound_key, metabolite_compound_key, met_conversion, pathway_key', 'From metabolism', 'Join compound_records as substrate_records on metabolism.substrate_record_id = substrate_records.record_id', 'Join compound_structures as substrate_structures on substrate_records.molregno = substrate_structures.molregno', 'Join compound_records as metabolite_records on metabolism.metabolite_record_id = metabolite_records.record_id', 'Left Join compound_structures as metabolite_structures on metabolite_records.molregno = metabolite_structures.molregno', 'Filter substrate_structures.canonical_smiles Is Not Null', 'Filter metabolism.met_conversion Is Not Null', 'Filter metabolism.pathway_key Is Not Null', 'Limit 200', 'Return canonical_smiles, substrate_record_id, metabolite_record_id, substrate_compound_key, metabolite_compound_key, met_conversion, pathway_key']
